subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should all five memory roles and per-agent overrides become durable public plugin API in this PR?
rationale: Implementation review can verify mechanics, but maintainers must own the long-term taxonomy, compatibility window, and external plugin contract before these keys ship.

options.title: Ship all five roles
options.body: Accept the full taxonomy after canonical-only runtime behavior, plugin-author documentation, and exact-head upgrade and isolation proof are present.

options.title: Narrow initial API
options.body: Ship only roles with established end-to-end runtime use and defer the remaining names to later protocol work.

recommendation.title: Ship all five roles
recommendation.body: Accept the full taxonomy after canonical-only runtime behavior, plugin-author documentation, and exact-head upgrade and isolation proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the central slot and memory runtime surfaces.
